preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line.strip(), str) for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Every line in stdin is a non-empty string.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) >= 1 and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The first line contains T (number of test cases), and each subsequent line contains exactly two space-separated integers N and K.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(N) <= 10**9 and 1 <= int(K) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for N in [line.split()[0]]) and all(1 <= int(K) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for K in [line.split()[1]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N and K are integers in the range [1, 10^9].

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()) == int(stdin.splitlines()[0]) for stdout in [stdout] for stdin in [stdin])
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i] == str((int(N) * int(K) + int(K) - 1) // int(K)) for i in range(len(stdout.splitlines())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for N, K in [line.split()] for stdout in [stdout])
postconditions.description: For each test case with N friends and K slices per pizza, the output is the smallest integer P such that K*P is divisible by N (i.e., P = ceil(N / K) if N is not divisible by K, else P = N / K). This ensures all slices can be evenly distributed among friends with no leftovers.
